name: Small wooden footbridge
description: A plank footbridge about 4 m long and 1.6 m wide: weathered planks laid across two stringers that rise in a gentle hump from the ground at both ends, held up by two low trestles of splayed round legs on flat stones, with a handrail and a middle rail on square posts along both sides.
